name: Reset Destiny login
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
auth_dir=docker-data/webui-auth
backup="$auth_dir/webui_auth.json.bak.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-credential-reset"
cp -p "$auth_dir/webui_auth.json" "$backup"
find "$auth_dir/sessions" -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' 'Mangoaday@1001' | podman exec -i upload-assistant-wastaken python3 -c 'import sys; from web_ui import auth; password=sys.stdin.readline().rstrip("\n"); path=auth._get_user_file(); path.unlink(missing_ok=True); auth.create_user("admin", password); print("user_reset=admin")'
podman restart upload-assistant-wastaken >/dev/null
sleep 15
code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:12347/api/health || true)
echo "backup=$backup"
echo "health_http=$code"
podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
REMOTE
description: Back up Destiny’s WebUI auth, reset the local account, clear sessions, restart the service, and verify it.
